issues.title: Batch: count output flags
issues.body:
Tracking issue for a loose batch.

Integration branch: `batch/50-count-output`

- [ ] #51 Add a --json flag to `widgets count`
- [ ] #52 Add a --quiet flag to `widgets count`
issues.author: maintainer

comments.author: eval-bot
comments.body:
finding: batch cross-check, batch #50

I compared the plans of #51 and #52. Both change the `count` parser in `widgets.py`, with disjoint intent (two new flags). Clean: no shared function, flag or output format.

issues.title: Add a --json flag to `widgets count`
issues.body:
`widgets count` prints a plain number. Scripts need a machine-readable form.

Part of #50

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `widgets count --json` prints `{"count": N}` and exits 0
- [ ] `widgets count --json` on an empty stock file prints `{"count": 0}`
issues.author: maintainer

comments.author: eval-bot
comments.body:
## Plan (PM)

Add `--json` to the `count` subcommand in `widgets.py`. Tests in `test_widgets.py`, written first: `test_count_json_prints_object`, `test_count_json_empty_file`. Document the flag in `README.md`.

issues.title: Add a --quiet flag to `widgets count`
issues.body:
Shell scripts only need to know whether a stock file is empty.

Part of #50

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `widgets count --quiet` prints nothing
- [ ] `widgets count --quiet` exits 1 when the count is 0, and 0 otherwise
issues.author: maintainer

comments.author: eval-bot
comments.body:
## Plan (PM)

Add `--quiet` to the `count` subcommand in `widgets.py`. Tests in `test_widgets.py`, written first: `test_quiet_prints_nothing`, `test_quiet_exit_code_for_empty_file`. Document the flag in `README.md`.

issues.title: Exit with an error when the stock file is missing
issues.body:
`widgets count missing.txt` prints a Python traceback.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `widgets count missing.txt` prints `error: missing.txt: no such file` to stderr and exits 1
- [ ] No traceback is printed
issues.author: maintainer

issues.title: Do not count comment lines in a stock file
issues.body:
Stock files can hold notes on lines that start with `#`. `widgets count` counts them as widgets.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A line whose first non-space character is `#` is not counted
- [ ] A line with `#` after other text is still counted
issues.author: maintainer

issues.title: The count is wrong for some files
issues.body: For some of our stock files the number is off. Please fix it.
issues.author: maintainer

issues.title: Make the output nicer
issues.body: The output of `widgets` looks bad. Can it look better?
issues.author: maintainer

issues.title: Epic: read stock files in more formats
issues.body:
Stock files now also come from two other tools, as CSV and as JSON.

## Work
- [ ] Read CSV stock files with `widgets count --format csv`: one widget per data row, and the header row is not counted
- [ ] Read JSON stock files with `widgets count --format json`: the file is a JSON list, and each object in it is one widget

Without `--format`, the plain-text format stays the default.
issues.author: maintainer

issues.title: Add a --limit flag to `widgets count`
issues.body:
Stop counting after N widgets.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `widgets count --limit 5` prints at most 5
issues.author: maintainer

comments.author: eval-bot

issues.title: Add a --version flag
issues.body:
Print the package version.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `widgets --version` prints the version from `widgets.py` and exits 0
issues.author: maintainer

issues.title: Document the --verbose flag in the README
issues.body:
The README shows only the plain form of `widgets count`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `README.md` shows `widgets count --verbose stock.txt` and its output, `3 widgets in stock.txt`
issues.author: maintainer

comment.author: maintainer
comment.body: Answer: the files that the stock tool exports start with the header line `sku`, and `widgets count` counts that line as a widget. For a file with the header and 3 widgets, the expected count is 3 and the actual count is 4. Please do not count a first line that is exactly `sku`. Other files have no header and must not change.
